question: What feed flow rate, nozzle size and inlet air temperature were used in the spray drying of the natural dye powders?
expect: 800 mL per hour, 0.6 mm nozzle, inlet 200 °C (4 bar, 18 L/min atomizing air, 4 m/s hot air) (sec. 2.2)
rendered:
Standardisation of natural dye powders via spray drying: initial physicochemical characterisation, page 3

The feed pump with a flow rate of 800 mL per hour was used to homogenize the extracted dye solution before it was atomized through an air-pressurized nozzle (0.6 mm size) with a fogging pressure of 4 bar and a fogging air flow rate of 18 L per minute to form fine droplets. Hot air was introduced into the drying chamber at an inlet temperature of 200 °C and a flow velocity of 4 m s−1 to provide the heat energy required for the drying process.
